|errata_history=Versions of [[All Wrapped Up (V)]] in [[Virtual Set 8: Jabba's Court]], in date order (3 versions). Slip texts are quoted as printed: ▼ and ▲ are the slips' arrow icons (deploy from / take into hand from Reserve Deck; reshuffle), and the immunity and pilot icons are the ones explained in each sheet's icon key (see [[Virtual card icons]]). Found while adding the original pre-Remaster slips (Bill, 12 November 2026).
* '''Original''' ([[All Wrapped Up (V) (Virtual Set 8)]]): release sheet “Virtual Set #8” (Players Committee; released 24 November 2004; PDF dated 24 November 2004), page 2, slip 26 — [https://web.archive.org/web/20041205113015/http://www.swccgpc.com:80/Resources/VirtualSet8Final.pdf VirtualSet8Final.pdf on swccgpc.com] (Internet Archive capture of 5 December 2004), announced in the [https://web.archive.org/web/20041204170841/http://www.swccgpc.com/interior.htm Committee's news post of 24 November 2004]: “Deploy on table. Your bounty hunter present may capture a just-forfeited character. Once per turn, you may ▲ an Effect with “Bounty” in its title. Bounty may deploy on captives at non-prison sites. Whenever you collect a bounty, you may take any one retrieved card into hand; place Bounty Effect out of play. Double Back is a Used Interrupt. A” The slip is the old pre-template slip the Committee used before its December 2006 Remaster: the Decipher-style lower half with the slip mark “8•26” at bottom right and no expansion icon.
* '''PC-E1''' (this page): a post by Kevin Brownell (“CubsFan”), the Committee's Marketing & Player Relations Advocate in the Committee's forum thread “Current Rulings/Errata” (“official rulings and errata issued by the Rules Committee”), 9 November 2005 ([https://web.archive.org/web/20060617231905/http://www.swccgpc.com/forums/viewtopic.php?t=4438 Internet Archive capture of 17 June 2006]): “Effective immediately, these five virtual cards are being errata'd as follows:” “Deploy on table. Your bounty hunter present may capture a just forfeited character. Once per turn, may /\ Bounty, which may deploy on captives at non-prison sites. Whenever you collect a bounty, may take one retrieved card into hand; place bounty Effect out of play. Double Back is a Used Interrupt. [Immune to Alter]” The post gives the text only (no slip image); in it “\/” and “/\” are the arrow icons and “(A)” / “[Immune to Alter]” the immunity icon. Stats and lore on this page are those of the earlier slip. '''What changed:''' the errata rewrote the text (full text above).
* '''PC-E2''' ([[All Wrapped Up (V) (Virtual Set 8) (Errata 2)]]): the Remaster sheet (official text as of 4 December 2006; [https://web.archive.org/web/20071026143738/http://www.swccgpc.com/Resources/VirtualCards8.pdf Internet Archive capture of 26 October 2007; later 2007 re-edits included], slip 26), in the Committee's Remaster template: “Deploy on table. Double Back is a Used Interrupt. Once per turn, may take Bounty into hand from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. If present, your bounty hunter may capture a character opponent just forfeited at same site. Whenever you collect a bounty, may place that Effect out of play to take a retrieved card into hand. (Immune to Alter.)” '''What changed:''' the Remaster rewrote the slip in the Committee's later wording (full text above; icons written out in words here). This is the current text of the Virtual Original card.
